recap.paragraph: Faizon Brandon races 55 yards for a touchdown, pushing Tennessee farther ahead! Earlier, George MacIntyre tossed a touchdown to DaSaahn Brame. LSU tied it at 13 when Sam Leavitt found Trey'Dez Green. Then Brandon ran 18 yards for the lead in Tennessee. His 2 clutch runs helped No. 9 Tennessee beat LSU 27-13. Tennessee is now 9-2 and still hopes to make the College Football Playoff.
